name: Nihon Parkerizing Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Parkerizing Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and supply of surface treatment chemicals in Japan and internationally. The company offers surface treatment chemicals for cleaning substrates, adding corrosion resistance, creating a base for painting, and providing lubrications; emulsion type rolling oil for rolling steel and cooling applications; heat exchangers, as well as offers technical support services. It also provides rust prevention, heat treatment, and rust stabilizing treatment services.
